messages:
anya: kicking off canary for model v3a-int4 at 09:12 UTC. this one was quantized with new per-block scale tuning. starting at 3% traffic.

rico: any special cohorts?

anya: yes — split by doc-length: short (<256), medium (256-2048), long (>2048). long-doc cohort gets a warm cache path.

li: quick heads-up: last time long-docs produced higher token churn and triggered rerank lower MRR. watch for MRR and token_churn metrics.

eva: baseline vs v3a-int4 A/B after 60m will compute bootstrap CI for MRR and top1 accuracy. auto-fallback thresholds are in experiment runner.

anya: current live snapshot: fraction 3%, short 60%, medium 30%, long 10% of canary slice. metrics: MRR_delta -0.005, top1 +0.2%, p95 +18ms, token_churn +6%.

rico: MRR dip small but token_churn up — might be harmless if accuracy stays. li, thoughts?

li: small negative MRR + token churn could mean beam reordering with quant noise. recommend soft-fallback for long-docs if MRR_delta < -0.007 OR token_churn > 0.08.

anya: propose two-tier auto-fallback: soft-route (send 20% of problem cohort to baseline) when warning conditions hit; hard-rollback if sustained for 20m and MRR_delta < -0.015 AND p95_rel > 0.30. Also add cohort-weighted aggregation to avoid small-sample noise.

ops-bot: note — deploy v3a-int4 (id mdl_v3a_int4_20260325) recorded. monitoring channel #canary-watch.

eva: here's the config i'd push to the canary runner (small-sample guarded):

```json
{
  "fraction": 0.03,
  "cohorts": ["short", "medium", "long"],
  "aggregator": "cohort_weighted",
  "fallback_policy": {
    "soft": {
      "criteria": [
        {"cohort": "long", "metric": "token_churn", "abs_gt": 0.08},
        {"cohort": "long", "metric": "rerank_mrr", "delta": -0.007}
      ],
      "action": "route_fraction",
      "route_fraction": 0.2
    },
    "hard": {
      "criteria": {
        "and": [
          {"metric": "rerank_mrr", "delta": -0.015},
          {"metric": "latency_p95", "rel_delta": 0.30}
        ]
      },
      "sustained_minutes": 20,
      "action": "rollback"
    }
  },
  "smoothing": {"exponential_half_life_minutes": 10}
}
```

li: nice. add a minimum-sample-count per cohort (e.g., 250 requests) to avoid triggering on tiny long-doc samples.

eva: will do. also adding bootstrap resamples=2000 for A/B significance and report p-value with effect size.

anya: operational ask: can ops schedule a targeted warmup job for the long-doc cache and tag the canary model with meta `cohort_watch=true`?

ops-bot: scheduled warmup job on infra1 for cohort long-doc at 09:25 UTC. tagging model metadata: cohort_watch=true.

rico: one more: add entropy-based check for output diversity collapse. sometimes quantization gives lower entropy which correlates with repetition. a check: if avg_output_entropy drops > 0.5 bits and MRR drops, treat as higher severity.

li: agree. include as escalation signal but not immediate rollback.

anya: agreed. timeline: warmup + 45m monitoring, then escalate if hard criteria hit. i'll post a short runbook note after. :white_check_mark:

eva: 45m snapshot (09:58): MRR_delta -0.009, top1 +0.1%, p95 +22ms, token_churn 0.09, avg_output_entropy -0.6 bits in long cohort.

rico: token_churn and entropy both over thresholds — trigger soft-route for long cohort.

ops-bot: routing update applied: 20% of long-cohort traffic redirected to baseline.

anya: monitoring — if soft-route reduces MRR hit below -0.005 and entropy stabilizes, keep canary and widen to 6% after next hour. if not, hard-rollback.

li: logging action items: 1) add min-sample-count guard, 2) add entropy alert to severity matrix, 3) implement cohort weighted aggregation, 4) update runbook.

ops-bot: no hard rollback triggered (last check 10:12 UTC).
